summary: GRANA, a granular sample player in the spirit of the MicroGranny 2: up to four sample layers played as a cloud of grains, with lo-fi effects, arpeggiator and sequencer. The on-screen interface and editor are in Italian.
features: Four layers, stacked or split across the keyboard
Grain size, density, spray, jitter, direction, four windows, freeze
Multimode filter, chorus-to-phaser or ring mod, tape echo, plate reverb
Two LFOs, arpeggiator, 64-step sequencer, scales; 64 named presets
User sample bank of 276 KB sent from a browser editor without reinstalling
USB and TRS MIDI, clock in and out, MIDI learn; optional Bluetooth build
